s3.ptxt: Push in the plunger and release it, and check that it quickly returns to its original position.

atten3.ptxt: Do not drop the plunger and return spring.

atten4.ptxt: If it does not return, replace the repair service starter kit.

s3.ptxt: Using SST (Toyota electrical tester), measure the resistance between terminals 50 and C.

atten4.ptxt: If the result is not as specified, replace the repair service starter kit.

s3.ptxt: Using SST (Toyota electrical tester), measure the resistance between terminal 50 and the repair service starter kit body.

atten4.ptxt: If the result is not as specified, replace the repair service starter kit.

s3.ptxt: Using vernier calipers, measure the brush length at the center.

atten4.ptxt: If the length is less than the minimum, replace the starter commutator end frame.

s3.ptxt: Using SST (Toyota electrical tester), measure the resistance between the positive (+) and negative (-) brush holders.

item.ptxt: If the result is not as specified, replace the starter commutator end frame assembly.

s3.ptxt: Using SST (Toyota electrical tester), measure the resistance between the segments.

atten4.ptxt: If the result is not as specified, replace the starter armature assembly.

s3.ptxt: Using SST (Toyota electrical tester), measure the resistance between the commutator and armature coil core.

atten4.ptxt: If the result is not as specified, replace the starter armature assembly.

s3.ptxt: Using vernier calipers, measure the height of the armature at the position shown in the illustration.

atten4.ptxt: If the value is more than the maximum, replace the starter armature assembly.

s3.ptxt: While holding the drive shaft, check that the pinion gear locks when turned clockwise and turns smoothly when turned counterclockwise.

atten4.ptxt: If it does not operate normally, replace the starter motor terminal kit.
